summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py with thread-entry state (_loop, _thread_id) initialized in __init__, set in run(), and cleared in a finally block. Added tests/test_concurrency.py with 8 tests covering not-running, same-thread, widget access, return value, awaitable, exception propagation, exit value, and call-after-stop; all pass when run with PYTHONPATH pointing at the repo src. Full suite shows the same 68 pre-existing failures with and without the change (async test support missing in the venv; tests/cli and tests/devtools skipped due to missing aiohttp). Nothing committed. Known gap: a call already scheduled while shutdown begins could wait on a loop that never runs it.
